steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. For live voltage checks, use proper PPE and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in service mode
steps.body: Service mode entered. Use Light key (SW2) to navigate to the step for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Use SW2 to advance steps; SW5 toggles loads.

steps.title: Navigate to service step 23
steps.body: Use Light key (SW2) to advance until Freezer TEMP LEDs show step 23 (FC door switch). Wait at least 1 second between key presses.

steps.title: FC compartment lights
steps.body: At step 23: Door open = FC lights ON; Door closed = FC lights OFF. THESEUS P3-5 FC door switch.
steps.sourceExcerpt: At step 23: Door open = FC lights ON; Door closed = FC lights OFF. THESEUS P3-5 FC door switch.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: FC lights do not respond — check P3-5 door switch.

steps.title: Replace FC door switch
steps.oemOutcome: Replace FC door switch or repair harness.

steps.title: FC door switch verified
steps.oemOutcome: FC door switch operates in step 23.
